parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is a composition root sitting in the infrastructure layer. It builds the concrete adapters (in-memory repositories and an ID generator) and the domain service. It wires those into the application use cases and controllers, then sets up the Express app: JSON middleware, route registration, an async error wrapper and an error handler. Wiring dependencies, configuring the transport and setting up the framework are all infrastructure work. The file contains no business rules, such as order-state checks, stock calculations or validation. The only logic in it is the `wrap` helper, which is framework glue that sends promise rejections to Express's `next`.
